mapper.select: SELECT m.*, d.name AS device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM maintenance_record m LEFT JOIN device d ON m.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON m.operator_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_record
AND device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance_record (device_id, operator_id, content, attachment_name, maintenance_date, next_maintenance_date, create_time) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{operatorId}, #{content}, #{attachmentName}, #{maintenanceDate}, #{nextMaintenanceDate}, NOW())
